d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Senegal has officially reclaimed the AFCON crown after the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) overturned a Confederation of African Football (CAF) appeals decision that had stripped Senegal of its title and awarded it to Morocco. The saga traces back to the January 18 final in Rabat, where a late penalty awarded to hosts Morocco prompted a 15-minute walk-off protest by Senegal's players before they returned, Brahim Diaz missed the spot-kick, and Pape Gueye scored an extra-time winner to hand the Teranga Lions a 1-0 victory—only for officials in…
